evals.prompt: Start a new application in a project path that contains spaces. Initialize the required project memory, then initialize it again after I add a custom repository rule.
evals.expected_output: Exactly six contract files are created on the first run, the second run creates none, and the custom rule is preserved byte-for-byte.
expectations: All six exact contract filenames exist under docs/
Repeated initialization reports zero created files
No pre-existing contract file is modified

evals.prompt: Open an existing project with one missing documentation file and a long agent history. Recover the missing file and prepare only the context needed to fix the active Roadmap task.
evals.expected_output: Only the missing file is created and startup context stays within 8 KiB while including repository rules, active work, summaries, and no more than five recent entries.
expectations: Exactly one missing contract file is recovered
The context output is at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes
The context contains no more than five real ledger entries
Cold history is not loaded

evals.prompt: Record more than 200 logical changes, rotate the hot ledger, and validate the project memory.
evals.expected_output: The oversized ledger is archived once, verified by SHA-256, replaced with a compact hot ledger that links to the archive, and validation passes without losing history.
expectations: Validation requires rotation before the oversized ledger can pass
Exactly one uniquely named history segment is created
The archive hash matches the pre-rotation ledger hash
The new hot ledger records the archive path and SHA-256
Validation passes after rotation

evals.prompt: In an empty folder, ask for 'a booking app'. Initialize project memory, answer only what the intake asks, and let the agent build the plan.
evals.expected_output: Exactly six contract files exist, the agent asks only for fields not already inferable from the request, and after answering, Roadmap.md has a complete ## Plan with the first task in ## Active work.
expectations: AGENTS.md exists at the project root and the five docs/ files exist
Questions asked are limited to fields references/intake.md could not fill from the request
Roadmap.md ## Plan contains a Fase -> Epic -> Tarea hierarchy after answers are given
## Active work has exactly one task after planning

evals.prompt: In a project with an existing CLAUDE.md and .cursorrules that both contain custom rules, run link. Run it a second time.
evals.expected_output: link adds a delimited pointer block to both files without altering the rest of either file, and the second run changes nothing.
expectations: CLAUDE.md and .cursorrules each contain the project-documentation block
The pre-existing custom content in both files is preserved byte-for-byte
A second run produces byte-identical files

evals.prompt: Two agents both run claim on the same task ID.
evals.expected_output: The first claim succeeds; the second fails with a clear message naming the current owner.
expectations: The first claim appends an IN_PROGRESS entry and updates the Roadmap row
The second claim exits non-zero and names the owning agent

evals.prompt: pause a task with category LIMITE, then have a different agent claim it.
evals.expected_output: The claim is allowed and its log entry follows the paused one.
expectations: pause requires and records a non-empty detail
A different agent's claim after a LIMITE pause succeeds

evals.prompt: pause a task with category ESPERA_RESPUESTA, then have a different agent try to claim it.
evals.expected_output: The claim fails until the blocking reason is resolved.
expectations: A different agent's claim after an ESPERA_RESPUESTA pause fails
The task's original owner can still reclaim it

evals.prompt: Claim a task, then record more than 200 log entries so the task's original claim entry falls out of the five latest, and run context.
evals.expected_output: The open task still appears in context under its own section, even though it is not among the five latest entries.
expectations: context includes an Open tasks section listing the still-open task
context stays at or below 8 KiB

evals.prompt: Claim a task, pad the ledger past the rotation threshold, and rotate.
evals.expected_output: The archived ledger keeps the full history; the new hot ledger carries forward a compact re-opened entry for the still-open task, and check passes.
expectations: status still reports the task as open after rotation
check passes after rotation with no missing-history errors

evals.prompt: Run done on a task with an empty verify argument, and separately append a log entry with an invalid status.
evals.expected_output: check fails on both: the empty-Verify DONE entry and the invalid-status entry are each reported as errors.
expectations: done itself rejects an empty verify before writing the entry
check reports the invalid-status entry as an error

evals.prompt: In a project still using docs/Agents.md with a custom repository rule, run check, then migrate, then check again. Run migrate a second time.
evals.expected_output: check fails first, naming migrate. migrate leaves a single root AGENTS.md with the custom rule preserved and docs/Agents.md removed; check then passes. The second migrate changes nothing.

docs/Agents.md no longer exists after migrate

evals.prompt: In a project with a hand-written root AGENTS.md containing project-specific rules, run init.
evals.expected_output: init inserts the skill's block into AGENTS.md without altering the existing content, and a second init changes nothing.
expectations: The pre-existing AGENTS.md content is preserved byte-for-byte outside the inserted block
A second init run produces a byte-identical AGENTS.md

evals.prompt: On a case-sensitive filesystem, create both AGENTS.md and Agents.md at the project root, then run check.
evals.expected_output: check fails, reporting that more than one case variant of AGENTS.md coexists.
expectations: check exits non-zero when both AGENTS.md and Agents.md exist at the root

evals.prompt: Build a PHASE -> EPIC -> TASK hierarchy in Roadmap.md as headings plus a task-row table (a `### F01 — <phase>` heading, a `#### F01-E01 — <epic>` heading, then a table row `F01-E01-T01`), then run check.
evals.expected_output: check passes: the hierarchy lives in heading levels and the Fnn-Enn-Tnn ID shape, the file contains no YAML or JSON, and the scripts never parse the headings themselves.
expectations: check passes on the hierarchy
The task row ID starts with Fnn and validates
Roadmap.md contains no fenced yaml or json block

evals.prompt: In three separate projects, break one canonical ID each: a Business rules row not shaped BR-xxx, a Technical decisions row not shaped ADR-xxx, and a Plan row not starting Fnn. Run check on each.
evals.expected_output: check fails every time and names the offending ID; a freshly initialized project passes check.
expectations: A fresh init scaffold passes check
Each failure message contains 'invalid ID format' followed by the offending ID
The Business rules, Technical decisions, and Plan checks are independent of each other

evals.prompt: Set a Product fact-table Status to `N/A`, and separately set a Roadmap row's Status to `CONFIRMED`, then run check on each.
evals.expected_output: check fails, naming the row and which Status vocabulary was violated: epistemic (CONFIRMED/HYPOTHESIS/UNKNOWN) in Product and Stack, workflow (TODO/IN_PROGRESS/PAUSE/DONE) in Roadmap.

CONFIRMED in a Roadmap Status column is rejected as an invalid workflow Status
UNKNOWN in a Product or Stack Status column is accepted

evals.prompt: Remove `<!-- context:end -->` from Roadmap.md, and separately remove the `## Out of scope` section from a contract file, then run check on each.
